title: lead35: short-horizon lead-lag; leader makes a sharp M1 move, follower has not moved yet, trade the follower's catch-up
before_registration: Only synthetic self-checks (lead35.py check) and signal counts (lead35.py counts; reads prices up to the signal bar only, no follower path after t, no cross-correlation) ran. Prior knowledge: xvol9/xvol10 (simultaneous cross-instrument bursts) negative, moves ended inside the burst bar; pairs16 (spread mean reversion) negative, spreads revert slower than holds. lead35 differs: it conditions on the follower NOT having moved yet and trades the catch-up in the leader's direction.
data: engine M1 bid/ask cache (history.db candles_ba snapshot), cut 2026-10-07 18:30 UTC; mid = (bid + ask) / 2 per OHLC field; M5 built from M1 per instrument (5-minute floor buckets)
step0: descriptive only, no verdict: Pearson corr(rL[m-lag], rF[m]) of M1 log mid-close returns, lag 0..5, on minutes where both instruments have the bar and the previous bar, per pair and window
atr: Wilder ATR(10) on each instrument's own bars (mid OHLC), taken as of bar t-k (the bar before the return window)
signal: at the close of bar t: zL = (cL[t]-cL[t-k])/ATR_L[t-k] with |zL| >= 2.0, s = sign(zL); follower zF = (cF[t]-cF[t-k])/ATR_F[t-k] with s*zF < 0.5 (lagging; includes opposite moves); bars t-k..t present for both; one signal per 10 minutes per pair (greedy; M5: 2 bars); k in {1, 3}
trade: follower in direction s; entry at the open of bar t+1 (must exist); exit at the close of the last follower bar in [t+1, t+h]; h = 5 primary, 2 and 10 secondary
outcome: gross = s*(exit-entry) on mid, in follower ATR(10)[t-k] units (primary) and bps; net: long buys ask_o[t+1] and sells bid_c[exit], short sells bid_o[t+1] and buys ask_c[exit]
primary: XAU->XAG, M1, k = 1, h = 5, mean gross in follower ATR units; day-block bootstrap (validate.day_boot, block 5 trading days, 1000 reps, seed 35, all trading days with a bar in the window)
pass_rule: PASS if the 95% CI lower bound of the primary is above 0 in BOTH dev and w2023; otherwise FAIL
secondary: never decide the verdict: k = 3; other five pairs; h = 2 and 10; M5 version; hit rate; signal counts; time-of-day split of the signal close (Asia 22-07, London 07-13, NY 13-21 UTC); MDE80 = 2.8 x bootstrap sd; net; control 'nolag' = same leader signal without the follower condition
trials: every cell logged to trials.jsonl with exp lead35
